name: @caotang/import-novelcrafter
description: The NovelCrafter manuscript and codex reader for the NovelCrafter import (#292): a codex export zip (one folder per entry with entry.md, metadata.json and notes.md) and any manuscript Markdown, read over the Markdown reader into the import block list with codex entries, aliases, relations and thumbnails. No DOM and no third-party dependencies, so it runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
